projects.name: Portfolio — Mikaël Wawrziczny
projects.description: Personal portfolio built with Nuxt 3, fully typed with TypeScript, featuring advanced SEO, i18n, automatic dark mode, animations, integrated AI project and a custom design system.

problemsSolved.problem: Senior freelancers often struggle to showcase a modern, fast, multilingual portfolio that truly reflects their skill level.
problemsSolved.solution: Creation of a highly optimized Nuxt 3 portfolio: hybrid SSR/CSR rendering, Apple-style design system, integrated AI chat, animated pages, scalable architecture, persistent dark/light mode.
problemsSolved.impact: Exceptional performance, increased recruiter conversion, direct demonstration of Nuxt 3 / TypeScript / AI expertise.

projects.name: Chasse en Cours
projects.description: Flutter mobile app (currently being rewritten in React Native) allowing hunters and hikers to declare a hunting zone on a map to inform people nearby.

problemsSolved.problem: Hikers are often unaware of ongoing hunting activities in nearby areas.
problemsSolved.solution: Simple declaration system using Google Maps to mark hunting zones.
problemsSolved.impact: Helps avoid dangerous areas and reassures families, hikers and outdoor athletes.

projects.name: OSS Nation
projects.description: International BJJ events platform with geolocation, Firebase, Firestore, advanced filters and multilingual support.

problemsSolved.problem: BJJ practitioners struggle to find seminars near them.
problemsSolved.solution: Geolocated search engine with date / distance / country filters.
problemsSolved.impact: Increased visibility for academies and smoother user experience.

projects.name: GhostLock
projects.description: Web content protection platform powered by Node.js, Bun, SQLite, Stripe and AI.

problemsSolved.problem: Premium content is difficult to protect on the web.
problemsSolved.solution: Invisible JS snippet + smart copy detection + AI alerts.
problemsSolved.impact: Up to 80% reduction in detected copy attempts.

projects.name: MCI
projects.description: Flutter mobile app with a Nuxt 3 admin dashboard allowing retailers to build customer loyalty and easily manage their services.

problemsSolved.problem: Retailers lacked a simple tool to retain customers and promote their services.
problemsSolved.solution: Creation of a Flutter mobile app focusing on loyalty and communication.
problemsSolved.impact: Higher customer engagement and better visibility for offers.
